expected_source: SPRU862B chapter 2 gives the only coherence hardware maintains: a DMA master's accesses to L2 SRAM are snooped against L1D, so a DMA write updates a line the CPU is holding and a DMA read is served from a line the CPU holds dirty. Both directions are derived from that alone - the checksum is folded in Python over the priming reads, the received length, the sixteen frame bytes the CPU must see without any cache operation, and the transmit descriptor's length; the expected frame is the injected one with its address fields swapped and every byte from the ethertype on replaced by a pattern written only into L1D, so a model that reads memory instead sends 0xA5 padding. L1DMODE 111b is the whole 32K as cache (SPRU871K chapter 4)
